e.title: openRiskScore (Python)
e.summary: 风险评分框架（Open Risk，49★）：经典与联邦/去中心化场景的风险评分建模
e.body: openRiskScore（Open Risk，49★，Apache-2.0）是 Python 风险评分框架：支持经典与联邦/去中心化两种场景的风险评分建模（含联邦模型示意图与数学文档，对接 Open Risk Manual）。对 RIAA：风险评分建模与隐私保护（联邦学习）视角——与 [[credit-risk]]（概念）、[[transitionmatrix]]（同组织转移矩阵库）配套；联邦评分与 [[explainable-ai-fraud]] 的可解释评分方向互补。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：Open Risk 风险评分框架（经典+联邦/去中心化），49★
e.summary_en: Risk-scoring framework (Open Risk, 49★): risk scoring in classic and federated/decentralised settings
e.summary_hk: 風險評分框架（Open Risk，49★）：經典與聯邦/去中心化場景的風險評分建模
e.body_en: openRiskScore (Open Risk, 49★, Apache-2.0) is a Python framework for risk scoring in both classic and federated/decentralised contexts (with federated-model illustrations and mathematical documentation linked to the Open Risk Manual). For RIAA: risk-scoring modelling with a privacy-preserving (federated) angle — pairs with [[credit-risk]] (the concept) and [[transitionmatrix]] (sister transition-matrix library from the same org); the federated-scoring angle complements the explainable-scoring direction of [[explainable-ai-fraud]].
e.body_hk: openRiskScore（Open Risk，49★，Apache-2.0）是 Python 風險評分框架：支持經典與聯邦/去中心化兩種場景的風險評分建模（含聯邦模型示意圖與數學文檔，對接 Open Risk Manual）。對 RIAA：風險評分建模與隱私保護（聯邦學習）視角——與 [[credit-risk]]（概念）、[[transitionmatrix]]（同組織轉移矩陣庫）配套；聯邦評分與 [[explainable-ai-fraud]] 的可解釋評分方向互補。
